entities.name: Nikaia, Illyria
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Nikaia was a settlement of the koinon of the Bylliones, an Illyrian tribe that through contact with their Ancient Greek neighbours became bilingual. The tribe was found in southern Illyria.
